title: ClientError missing #[non_exhaustive] — adding a variant is a breaking change
description: error.rs: ClientError is a public enum with no #[non_exhaustive]. Adding any new error variant (e.g. RateLimit, Timeout) is a semver breaking change for any caller that pattern-matches it exhaustively. The existing exhaustive-match test in error.rs helps within this crate only — external callers break silently at compile time when they upgrade. Pre-1.0 is not an excuse; the crate's own changelog says this will happen as it grows.
